scope: Three preparation-specific human functional primaries: one partial-source and two complete scientific-main qualifications. No all-magnesium or all-literature conclusion.

sources.identity: Magnesium oxide, product unspecified at accessed depth
sources.reading_depth: Complete official abstract, current registry and indexed publisher conclusion; full scientific main/native/supplements inaccessible.

population.training_context: All attending a mild weekly fitness program; no exercise-by-magnesium interaction qualified.
population.baseline_diet: Abstract says more evident below recommended dietary intake; exact stratum sizes, interaction/multiplicity and biochemical-deficiency mapping unverified.

intervention.article_dose: 300 mg Mg/day in magnesium-oxide form, 12 weeks
intervention.registry_dose_literal: 300 mg of daily oral magnesium oxide
intervention.dose_limit: Elemental versus salt-mass wording differs; no silent equivalence. Exact brand/excipients and received-dose data unverified.
intervention.comparator: No placebo; current registry describes healthy-diet education. Researchers blinded per abstract, participants not blinded by a matching pill. Registry masking NONE.

outcomes.strength: Secondary isometric/isokinetic lower-limb and handgrip outcomes null in complete abstract.
outcomes.dispersion_limit: Abstract does not define the ± statistic; not relabeled SD/SE/CI.
outcomes.contrast_limit: Abstract explicitly describes treatment-versus-control improvement; full adjusted model and native tables unverified.

sources.harms: No serious adverse effects reported in abstract; full mild-event/adherence tables not read.

registry_limits.interpretation: Enrollment/secondary-outcome/masking and dose-wording discrepancies preserved; registration after completion does not establish prospective specification.

sources.bubr1: No assay in portions read; inaccessible remainder not claimed absent.
sources.funding: Full-paper disclosure unverified; registry sponsor University of Padova.

notice_scope.classification: Comment in records, not identified as errata; text unreviewed.

sources.judgment: Mobility-functional reserve with source-access and unblinded-control limits; strength restoration not shown.

sources.reading_depth: Complete five-page original scientific main, all three native tables and both native figures. Public-copy title/DOI/pages matched official metadata.

population.condition: Stable CAD, usual medications and diet maintained

intervention.component_limit: Placebo composition insufficiently described to establish potassium matching or isolated magnesium causality. No transfer to every citrate product or other salt.

denominators.analysis: Methods states all randomized ITT, documented-data plus LOCF exercise-time analysis, per-protocol efficacy and ITT safety; analysis-specific exercise estimates not separately supplied.

exercise_duration_at_6_months.contrast: Direct post-treatment comparison; not a reconstructed change difference

intracellular_magnesium.tissue: Sublingual epithelial cells, not skeletal muscle
intracellular_magnesium.limit: No randomized deficiency-stratum treatment interaction; source refers to normal mean37.9±4mEq/L, not independently diagnosed clinical deficiency.

correlation_conflict.interpretation: Unresolved source discrepancy; association not causal mediation.

outcomes.force_mass_BUBR1_fidelity: Not measured in complete scientific article.

statistics_limits: No prospectively verified outcome hierarchy/protocol or own registry read.
Differential attrition and unclear presentation of observed/LOCF variants.

harms.limit: Retain alongside diarrhea-related withdrawal and questionnaire worsening; no general safety-superiority claim.

sources.independence: Earlier US50-person FMD report explicitly ancillary subset of this study, not independent replication. Separately encountered2006 CAD source unqualified; independence not assumed.
sources.supplements: None supplied with original five-page copy; no completeness claim.
sources.judgment: Real controlled cardiac exercise-tolerance comparator for the actual formulation, not proven isolated magnesium muscle restoration.

sources.reading_depth: Complete scientific main/declarations, all seven native main figures, complete three-page supplement text/nativeS1–S2, complete current registry.

intervention.dose_literal: 300 mg magnesium chloride (MgCl2/ReMag) twice daily for9 days
intervention.comparator: Otherwise matching lemon-flavored beverage without magnesium chloride
intervention.dose_limit: No independently inspectable lot certificates/hydration state; do not convert to600mg elemental magnesium/day or infer molecular-formula dose.
intervention.blind: Coded drinks; investigators remained blinded through final analyses.
intervention.bottle_issue: Visible mold in some plastic bottles led to recall/replacement in glass; study paused. Authors state no known ingestion of mold-containing drinks.

population.baseline_context: Regular exercisers; no diagnosed hypomagnesemia per authors; diet intake not measured; originally required fitness threshold dropped.
population.deficiency_limit: No independent deficiency classification from summary values; this was not a selected magnesium-deficient population.

outcomes.other_nulls: Ventilatory-threshold oxygen uptake, exercise lactate-response interaction, peak heart rate/RPE; do not infer universal endurance impairment.

ionized_magnesium.limit: Reported tests versus baseline, not a supplied formal active-versus-placebo treatment contrast.

biopsy_respiration.interpretation: OnlyD/E below.05; A–C trends not significant. Selected oxygen-consumption response, not measured ATP synthesis, BUBR1 or mediation.
biopsy_respiration.protocol_conflict: Main sequential0.5µM FCCP versus supplement1.0mM FCCP; unresolved.

outcomes.microbiome: No overall diversity/richness clustering differences; selected genera changes have separate FDR control and do not establish clinical harm or benefit.

statistics.performance: Two-sided paired t-tests; mean±SD; no reported contrast CIs
limitations: No described study-wide correction across performance/respirometry tests.
Biopsy study underpowered; authors separately report P<.10 trends.

harms.limit: Symptom reports are retained despite generic statement; no summed unique-patient incidence or safety equivalence inferred.

registry_limits.outcomes: Current registry lists many primary outcomes, including cytokines absent from main; article calls performance primary and other assays additional. Original prespecification not inferred.

sources.funding: New Capstone supplied/funded products. Authors declare no conflicts and no sponsor role in data/interpretation/publication; Think Healthy Group participated in design discussions and administered sponsor interactions.
sources.judgment: Controlled adverse performance and null endurance comparator for this brief ReMag regimen in regular exercisers; no universal magnesium harm claim.

competitive_judgment: Retain actual mobility/cardiac exercise positives and preparation-specific negative/null evidence. Fair functional-reserve comparison does not require BUBR1 assays, but no head-to-head/MVA/pediatric superiority follows. Niacin bridge and apitegromab SMA motor evidence remain distinct; no fresh nominee-primary credit.
identity_limit: Aquamin and ascorbate-phosphate unchanged; optional entries use empty match_aliases to prevent generic magnesium/salt/mixture joins.

source_markdown_sole_fix_history.old_clause: Methods excluded previous diagnosis rather than selecting a defined deficient cohort.
source_markdown_sole_fix_history.new_clause: the Introduction says participants had not previously been diagnosed, and the Discussion describes their baseline ionized values as within the reference range.
